description: Read an invoice by id (INV-XXXX-XXXX, with or without dashes): requested amount, token, network, receiver, status (open or paid), the paying transaction once paid, and received (the raw amount measured on-chain so far). Pending payments are re-checked on-chain by the read, at most two per read and each at most every 15 seconds. checks lists the older paid screening of an invoice created before 07/11/2026 ([] for new ones), which paying runs on both wallets once analysis.status is paid; payerChecks lists the analysis of the paying wallet the receiver asked and paid for. receiverAnalysisFee, on an open invoice where the payer can buy the receiving wallet analysis (invoice_analysis_pay with checks): {available: true, amount} is the charge in dollars, the bracket fee of the invoice amount, or {available: false, minimum} when the amount is below the minimum and there is nothing to buy. For such an older invoice, analysis.report (Merkle Science only) carries, once the invoice is paid, the detail of both wallets; for payerChecks the result goes to the creator alone, on the site, and does not come here (over the web app, a signed session of the creator also sees the detail of the receiving wallet while it is open): score, severity, summary, main risk category, risk factors and sourceOfFunds (the largest origins of the money, up to 8, with category, entity, percentage, USD amount and direct or indirect exposure). confidential is true only on a private invoice created before 14/10/2026: its receiver reads null here, it can no longer be paid (invoice_pay answers private_invoice_paused), and its paying transaction, once paid, shows the receiver on-chain.
name: invoice_get
